span.p:
privacy/scrub.py
English and Sinhala, spoken digits too
PINs · passwords · one-time codes
gate, lock and alarm codes
card numbers (Luhn) · NIC numbers
bank account numbers

div.style: color: rgb(19, 35, 43) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
“The gate code is [hidden].”
in every transcript and fact

div.style: color: rgb(19, 35, 43) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Its piece of speech silenced
in the stored video (3.5 s)

div.style: color: rgb(19, 35, 43) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SAM 3.1 looks through the whole video
for credit cards, identity cards
and phone screens · two frames a second,
on a copy made from the upload at 1280 px

div.style: color: rgb(19, 35, 43) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Code blurs each box in the video,
half a second either side of every frame
it was seen in, and in the stills

div.style: color: rgb(19, 35, 43) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Medicine instructions
“half a tablet of her
pressure medicine every morning”

div.style: color: rgb(19, 35, 43) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Never a step · listed for
the owner under Not used,
with the reason

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 420px; text-align: center;

span.p:
A staging folder · nothing of the recording
is kept, or can be opened, until all of this is done

span.p:
Only the household's own folder · no copies of model output anywhere else ·
Delete this home removes it all
